verdict.rationale: Mollie ships an official MCP server (mcp.mollie.com/mcp) letting users issue natural-language commands via Claude Desktop, Cursor, or VS Code to create/manage Mollie resources (payments, subscriptions, customers, etc.), and a live probe confirms the endpoint is real and OAuth-protected rather than vaporware. Missing for 10: independent hands-on user reports of successful NL command execution, and confirmation that all core APIs (not just the documented subset) are reachable via the MCP tool set.
